acceptanceCriteria: A heredoc or Write payload containing a while/sleep loop as file content is not refused.
A real foreground until/while sleep polling command is still refused.
Both cases covered by the hook's tests.
body: Observed 2026-10-19 in the V1-1942 lane: the PreToolUse no-polling-loops hook matched `while :; do ... sleep` inside a Go test string written via a python3 heredoc and refused the edit. The loop was file content (a shell stand-in for a test), not a shell polling loop. Expected: the hook inspects the executed command, not heredoc/file payloads, or exempts writes into test sources. Actual: false-positive refusal, forcing a workaround.
title: Lane 'no polling loops' PreToolUse hook refuses file edits whose content contains a while/sleep loop
